text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Wavefront preview cohort kickoff is next week. Need to lock seat allocation, schedule two enablement sessions, and confirm the feedback cadence with the product team. Can we triage actions here?

leo_pm: On it. How many seats are still unclaimed? I thought we had 18 total, 12 accepted.

maria_cs: Correct — 18 seats. Right now 12 accepted, 3 pending invite, 3 waitlisted. Pending invites are for QuarryX, OlaHealth, and Pique Labs.

ashley_se: I can take QuarryX and OlaHealth onboarding. Need contact emails and whether they need SSO or API keys.

maria_cs: QuarryX: sara@quarryx.com (SSO). OlaHealth: onboarding@olahealth.io (API keys). Pique Labs asked for a week delay — put them on waitlist for now.

devon_support: Noted. I'll pre-provision API keys for OlaHealth and tag them with the preview flag. Also will create a short runbook for first-login issues.

leo_pm: For feedback cadence — propose: 1) 24h onboarding survey, 2) 1-week product-use check, 3) 3-week qualitative interview for top 5 users. Keeps noise down while giving us signal. Thoughts?

evan_eng: That sounds good. Add an automated telemetry snapshot at 48hrs (token usage, latency percentiles, error rates) and dump to the cohort dashboard. I can wire that to the console.

maria_cs: Perfect. Can you add a small alert when any customer crosses 5% error rate or latency > p95 baseline? We want to proactively reach out before they get stuck.

evan_eng: Yep — will add a cohort-level alert. Also will attach a short anonymized report to the survey emails.

ashley_se: For enablement sessions: recommend two 45-mins slots — (A) Quick start + integration examples, (B) Ops & debugging + best practices. I can run A, devon can run B.

devon_support: Happy to run B. I'll prepare the ops checklist and a troubleshooting doc.

maria_cs: Scheduling note — customers prefer weeknight slots 4pm PT; can we offer Mon/Thu as options?

leo_pm: Monday 4pm PT and Thursday 4pm PT saved as T1/T2. Maria, can you ping customers with those options? Use this invite template: ```Hi <name>, would you be available for a 45-min enablement on [Mon 4pm PT / Thu 4pm PT]? Agenda: 1) Quickstart & examples 2) Ops & debugging 3) Q&A. Reply with preferred slot.```

maria_cs: Copy. I'll send invites today. I also want to capture any renewal-risk signals early. Who should flag a high-risk account in the sheet?

ashley_se: I'll flag risk if integrations stall >7 days or if customers report repeated errors. Add a "risk_reason" column in the cohort tracker.

maria_cs: Good. Devs, please note: if any customer requires model quantization or special infra we should capture that in the ticket so PM can prioritize.

evan_eng: Will do — create tickets for infra requests and tag with "wavefront-preview".

leo_pm: One more — feedback capture: we need a single canonical place for qualitative notes. Can we use the Feedback doc (link pasted in thread) and then export top themes after week 3?

maria_cs: Yes. I'll maintain the feedback doc and drop short summaries into the cohort dashboard weekly.

cs_bot: Reminder scheduled: send onboarding invites at 1719350000, run 24h survey at 1719420000, and compile week-1 telemetry report at 1719410000.

maria_cs: Thanks team — action items: Ashley (QuarryX + OlaHealth onboarding, flag risk), Devon (pre-provision keys, run ops session), Evan (telemetry + alerts), Leo (manage slots & feedback summary). I'll follow up after invites go out. :thumbsup:
